skills: Up to 4 hits: two Physical, two Electric. Getting hit between the 3rd hit's retreat and the 4th triggers an automatic dodge.
Her mech's charged punch for massive Electric DMG. Reaching 120 Steel Charge gives one quick use by holding.

Steel Charge (max 150, starts at 60) builds from her hits. At 120, after Slaughter or her Ultimate, press to spend 60 for First Form, then 60 more for Second Form: sweeping shots and a jumping smash for massive Electric DMG.
Thrown steel wheels for Physical DMG.
Parries an incoming attack for massive Daze.
Floating turrets fire for Electric DMG.
Curving steel wheel for Electric DMG.
Flight mode: move freely while firing missiles for massive Electric DMG; hold to keep going, draining Energy. Release for Away. After 60 Energy in one flight, auto-casts Slaughter.
Release during flight: rapid cannon fire for Electric DMG.
Mech cannon shots and missiles for massive Electric DMG.
Pilots the mech: missiles, a rocket shower and a jumping smash for massive Electric DMG. +60 Steel Charge.

core.name: Flower Chain Protocol
core.text:
Her Vanguard is the Attack teammate with the highest initial ATK. The Vanguard's EX gives Seed Onslaught (+{0} ATK, +{1}% CRIT DMG); Seed's EX gives the Vanguard Direct Strike (the same). With both up, both get Besiege: +{2}% DMG. These last 40s and work while on-field (or 3s after switching out). Entering battle with a Vanguard gives everything at once.
Each Energy the on-field Vanguard or Seed spends gives her 0.5 Steel Charge.

ability.name: Surprise Strike
ability.text: Her on-field hits give the Vanguard 2 Energy (once per 1s). Slaughter, Downfall and her Ultimate deal +30% DMG and ignore 25% Electric RES.

mindscapes: Downfall works from 100 Steel Charge and costs 100 total; quick Slaughter needs 100. +40 Steel Charge entering battle, +20 on Ultimate. Downfall CRIT DMG +30%.
Besiege also ignores 20% DEF. Flight can go on to 120 Energy, and every 5 Energy spent gives the next Slaughter +5% DMG.
During Besiege: +10% Decibel generation and +20% Ultimate DMG.
+50% CRIT DMG. Slaughter fires 3 extra lasers for 165% ATK each (once per 3s).
